name: mc-agent-api
description: HTTP API that lets AI agents play Minecraft Java Edition through mineflayer bots (one isolated bot per login).

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('src', { recursive: true })) if (f.endsWith('.js')) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'src/' + f])"
